components.name: combined-preparation
components.command:
set -euo pipefail
mix do deps.get + compile --warnings-as-errors + ecto.create + ecto.migrate + run priv/repo/seeds.exs

components.name: playwright-browser-install
components.command:
set -euo pipefail
set -euo pipefail
if [ "$CACHE_HIT" = "true" ]; then
  npx playwright install-deps $BROWSERS
else
  npx playwright install --with-deps $BROWSERS
fi

components.name: native-owner-invocation
components.command:
set -euo pipefail
mkdir -p playwright-report
npx playwright test \
  tests/golden-path.spec.ts \
  tests/ga-uat-shift-left.spec.ts \
  tests/passkeys-hooks.spec.ts \
  tests/organizations.spec.ts \
  tests/passkey-login.spec.ts \
  tests/passkey-options.spec.ts \
  --retries=0 \
  --list --reporter=json > playwright-report/non-admin-smoke.selection.json
